title: Keep saying yes to giving
odia:
ଦେବା ଦେବା କହୁଥିବା
ନାହିଁ ନଦେବା ନକରିବା।
literal_meaning: Keep saying, “We will give, we will give”; do not answer, “No, we will not give.” [Editorial parsing of the compressed second line.]
meaning_odia: ଦେବା ଦେବା ବୋଲି କହୁଥିବା, ନାହିଁ ଦେବୁ ନାହିଁ ବୋଲି ଉତ୍ତର ନକରିବା—ଏପରି ଭାବେ ଆମେ ଏଠାରେ ସଂକ୍ଷିପ୍ତ ଦ୍ୱିତୀୟ ଧାଡ଼ିକୁ ପଢ଼ୁଛୁ। ଏହି ପାଠରେ କଥାଟି ସିଧାସଳଖ ମନା କରିବା ବଦଳରେ ସକାରାତ୍ମକ ଆଶ୍ୱାସନ ଦେବାକୁ ନେଇ। ପ୍ରକୃତରେ ଦେଲେ କି ନାହିଁ ମୂଳରେ କୁହାଯାଇନାହିଁ।
explanation: The repeated positive answer is set against a refusal that should not be spoken. Our editorial parsing reads the line as a formula for keeping the answer agreeable. It could sound reassuring or evasive in different situations; the wording alone does not settle whether the promise is carried out.
usage_example: Original imagined example: During a discussion of a request, someone recalls this saying about continuing to say yes. Another asks what practical commitment those assurances will mean.
cultural_context: Repetition gives ଦେବା the sound of a ready assurance. The second line packs several negatives together; this translation treats “no, we will not give” as the reply being ruled out, while retaining the source text unchanged.
